title: Getting Started with Excel
description: Excel stores data in a grid and calculates results from formulas.
objectives: Use File → New to complete a practical task.
Check the result: A saved workbook with one expense.
concepts: Excel stores data in a grid and calculates results from formulas.
Command location: File → New. Desktop Windows instructions are used; Mac and web controls may differ.
steps: Open Excel and choose Blank workbook
Type Item in A1 and Cost in B1
expectedResult: A saved workbook with one expense.
tips: Work on a practice copy and save after each major change.
Compare your finished output with the expected result before moving on.
mistakes: Saving before checking the file location

projects.title: Student marksheet
projects.task: Enter names and three subject marks in B2:D6. Use =SUM(B2:D2) for totals and =AVERAGE(B2:D2) for averages, then fill down.
projects.expectedResult: For marks 60, 70 and 80, verify total 210 and average 70.

projects.title: Monthly budget
projects.task: Enter budgeted amounts in B2:B6 and actual spending in C2:C6. Use =B2-C2 for remaining budget and SUM for totals.
projects.expectedResult: For budget 1000 and spending 750, remaining budget must be 250.

projects.title: Attendance sheet
projects.task: Use validation labels Present, Absent and Late in B2:F2. Use =COUNTIF(B2:F2,"Present") to count attended days.
projects.expectedResult: Three Present entries must produce a count of 3.

projects.title: Salary calculator
projects.task: Enter basic pay in B2, allowance in C2 and deductions in D2. Calculate =B2+C2-D2 in E2.
projects.expectedResult: Basic 20000, allowance 2000 and deductions 1500 must give net pay 20500. Use sample data only.

projects.title: Result analysis
projects.task: Calculate averages, highest marks and count of passes using =COUNTIF(B2:B6,">=40"). Chart the distribution.
projects.expectedResult: Recount qualifying marks manually and compare with the formula.

projects.title: Sales report
projects.task: Enter regions, products and amounts in a table. Insert a PivotTable with Region in Rows and Sum of Amount in Values.
projects.expectedResult: Region subtotals must add up to the source SUM; refresh after edits.

projects.title: Inventory sheet
projects.task: Enter opening stock in B2, received in C2 and sold in D2. Use =B2+C2-D2 for closing stock and highlight low balances.
projects.expectedResult: Opening 25, received 10 and sold 8 must give closing stock 27.

projects.title: Expense tracker
projects.task: Enter date, category and amount for ten expenses. Apply filters and use SUMIF to total a chosen category.
projects.expectedResult: The sum of category subtotals must match the total expense amount.

projects.title: Grade calculator
projects.task: Enter a score in B2. Use =IF(B2>=80,"A",IF(B2>=60,"B",IF(B2>=40,"C","Retry"))). Validate scores between 0 and 100.
projects.expectedResult: Check boundaries: 80 → A, 60 → B, 40 → C and 39 → Retry.
